title: How Chime's CEO has build a company that can last | TechCrunch Disrupt 2025
description:
Chris Britt knows how to build a company that withstands headwinds and seizes rare opportunities. As co-founder and CEO of Chime, he’s led the fintech from scrappy challenger to one of the few to go public in today’s tough market. In this TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 conversation, Britt shares what it takes to scale with discipline, stay resilient through market shifts, and make the leap from private to public when so few manage it.
